notes.title: Playtest is now open!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi!

We're finally reached the point when we’re ready to open the public playtest of Surreal Deal. It’s not squeaky-clean [i]-yet-[/i], but here’s where we’re asking for your help in catching those last bugs![/p][p]Join the playtest queue on the Surreal Deal store page. We will be admitting users in small batches. [/p][p]Our discord server is now open only for testers. But we’re planning to open it up for everybody once we’ve collected enough feedback. Looking forward to hearing from you![/p][p]See you there, Sunsoup[/p][p]
[/p]
